summary: To join the Ansible community package, a collection must meet its requirements and be selected by the Steering Committee via the inclusion process.
questions: How does a collection get included in the Ansible community package?
Who decides which collections are in the Ansible package?

answer_card.title: Getting into the Ansible package
answer_card.answer_md: Meet the Ansible community package collection requirements, then go through the inclusion process. The **Steering Committee** selects collections.
